experiment: multi-reference runtime use of uniform deformation rings on a held-out Nailsea candlestick

reference.asset: one specific rare 19th-century Nailsea hollow-stem glass candlestick, c. 1830

view_roles.view_1: complete elevation and primary outer profile
view_roles.view_2: lower-foot transition, wall thickness cues, and pulled-trail detail
view_roles.view_3: upper knop and socket transition detail
view_roles.view_4: oblique top/bottom evidence confirming circular foot and hollow circular socket

reference.media_policy: source photos remain ignored in runs/*/media; only measurements, notes, and model evidence are committed
reference.measurement: GrabCut outer contour from full elevation, then centered rotational reconstruction from detected per-row span
cross_checks: measured source-mask width/height is 0.292857; published 9/30.5 ratio is 0.295082
oblique and bottom views independently confirm rotational circularity
detail views confirm continuous smooth glass transitions rather than stacked primitive seams
top/oblique view confirms a real hollow socket

held_out_rule: This same-object photo set was found only after rejecting the earlier single-photo target. It was not used to create or transfer-validate the skill, and no source mesh exists or was inspected.

strategy.primary_object: one connected 12-sided radial all-quad control shell shaped in Edit Mode
strategy.topology: one cylinder, cap removal, one planner-selected 31-cut operation producing 33 axial rings, then measured ring scaling
modifiers: SOLIDIFY inward for hollow glass wall
strategy.shading: Smooth by Angle after geometry and modifier decisions
strategy.decoration_scope: pulled white trails are material decoration and are not authored as fake structural geometry in this form-validation run

required_skill_flow.execution: planner loop cut and every artistic mutation use begin/perform/verify/commit

frozen_acceptance_gates.audit: fresh factory-startup Blender verifier passes without importing the generator, followed by visual review of solid, matcap, wireframe, front overlay, and top evidence

promotion_rule: Only this corrected multi-reference run can add runtime_usage. The rejected single-photo run cannot promote the skill.
